questions.subject: Physics
questions.stem: In Schedule 08 Question 1: If the absolute temperature of an ideal gas is quadrupled, by what factor does the root-mean-square (RMS) speed of gas molecules change?
questions.solution: RMS speed v_rms = sqrt(3*R*T / M). When T -> 4T, v_rms -> sqrt(4)*v_rms = 2*v_rms.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.stem: In Schedule 08 Question 36: An ideal monoatomic gas has 38 degrees of freedom f = 3. What is the molar heat capacity at constant volume Cv in terms of gas constant R? (Enter ratio Cv/R as float).
questions.solution: For monoatomic gas with translational degrees of freedom f = 3, Cv = (f/2) * R = 1.5 R.
